name: roforge-studio
description: RoForge Studio — Multi-Agent Roblox Game Factory powered by local Gemini CLI

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan,magenta "npm --workspace=server run dev" "npm --workspace=client run dev"
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT,DESKTOP -c cyan,magenta,green "npm --workspace=server run dev" "npm --workspace=client run dev" "npm --workspace=desktop run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client && npm run build:desktop
